value: Demo for a power-wash sim style miniguy game.

In Eastcloud city, tiny folk live on the sidelines, keeping to themselves. Tired of your life in the village, you decide to pack your bags and move out into the big city. You look for a job with a giant office lady named Elma. When asked about your personal ambitions, Elma dismisses them, and hires you as a foot cleaner instead.
